production.direction_en: Night on the far bank. Mahmut sits with his back to the bridge. Fadyme brings two cups of weak tea.
production.music_direction_en: bgm_camp (night, very sparse); two cups of tea: no melody, just a warm pad

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You have not spoken since the span.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: He taught me to hold a shield. He signed the order that made me drop it.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: And tonight he held a bridge.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Does that make him better or worse?

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: It makes him a man who was late. You know how that feels.

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: For once, she kept watch, and he slept.
